original.statement: The implicit IPv4 preference applied when JMX is enabled has been removed; the JVM defaults now apply.

decision.reason: [ev-6b927d45a8a3] says "Implicit IPv4 preference when enabling JMX has been removed, and will now use JVM defaults". That supports a protocol-behavior subject named from the evidence's own words, with change type removed. "implicit" is worth keeping in the name: what was removed is the automatic preference that came with enabling JMX, not any IPv4 preference an operator sets explicitly. The validators were inconclusive (not render-verifiable), so this rests on the changelog text alone.
